title: Mixed Event — Show Your Shine — Episode2 To the Shops

meta.Event Outline: On her way to replace her torn jacket at the mall, Kanade has an encounter with Saki that leads to them setting up a teatime chat. That's when Saki asks her to be the model for her fashion project, of all things...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Kanade!
This shop carries lots of different types of outerwear!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...
I don't even know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They seem to be sorted based on category.
This looks like the corner for basic coats, and those are all casual jackets...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, look at this boa fleece! It's so fluffy and adorable!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was a little worried that she wouldn't get to have much fun helping me shop...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's even reversible!
And both colors are really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I guess my worries were misplaced.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I shouldn't be the one having all the fun. I almost forgot that we're here to find you a new jacket, Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you have any particular styles or traits in mind?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, above all else, it needs to be warm...
But not too heavy, if possible.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What else...? It'd be nice if it were made of a material that's easy to maintain. Also, a simple design would be preferable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see.
In other words, it needs to be comfortable and easy to keep clean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, we might want to try going over to the outdoor goods shop...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Recently, all the big outdoor brands have been making really cute clothes that you can wear day to day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had no idea. Then, why don't we go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... Would you mind showing me the way?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course♪ It's right this way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here we are! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, these come in simple designs...
I could wear these like normal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. See what I mean?
All that's left is to find something that's both warm and light...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what about this down jacket?
It's fluffy but not heavy, and seems really warm!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. It shouldn't be all that taxing to wear this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, these overcoats also seem pretty versatile!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can block the wind and stay warm by popping the collar... Hey, it even says that you can throw it in a washing machine!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you don't have to send it to the dry cleaners...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know. If you're interested in any of these, then why don't you try them on? We can try asking the staff.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, let's do that.
Umm... Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you were able to find a jacket you like!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Tenma.
There's no telling how long that would've taken if I were by myself. Honestly, I might've gotten exhausted and picked something just to be done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It's nice to know that you should be able to have a warm and cozy winter now♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you've been a tremendous help.
Which is why I'd like to repay the favor somehow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you don't have to do that!
I wanted to help you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, while looking around with you, I ended up finding a really cute scarf♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, I had a really fun time today thanks to you, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you're able to pull off whatever you wear! I really enjoyed watching you try on different clothes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, there's no need to pay me back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I would like to chat with you some more, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Ichi and Hona have already told me so much about you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been hoping that we'd get a chance to sit down and chat!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't guarantee that we're going to strike up a good conversation. So, as long as you're okay with that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but I have work after this...!
Can we meet again sometime soon?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Then, we should probably swap our contact info!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I forget how to actually do that on this device...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You tap here, hit this mark and...
Oh, there we go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I can add you as a friend now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
All done!
Hehe. Thank you again so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll message you later!
We can go to a cafe or something!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know if chatting with me will make up for what she did today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I am sort of looking forward to talking to her again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I went to grab a blanket.
And a toasty drink while I was at it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it has been freezing lately.
It's hard to work at night without those things...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, aren't you cold? I mean, if I don't turn the heater on, I can't draw because my hand becomes completely frozen!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess artists do have it pretty rough this time of year. But speaking of how cold it's been...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You said you were gonna buy a new jacket, K. Did you already get one?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, yes... I managed to get one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <What's more, while I was walking over to the mall today...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really?! And Saki helped you pick it out?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, she helped me find a good one after asking me about my preferences. I really can't thank her enough...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, I'm just as surprised that you went out to buy new clothes yourself, K...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, a jacket from an outdoor goods shop... I wouldn't have thought of that, but it probably does suit you really well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Especially since they make stuff with cute designs now♪ I might go over sometime to try and dig up a few hidden gems.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Hm? My phone says I have a message.
But from who...?)

rows.Speaker: Message from Saki
rows.Line:
<Thank you again for today, Kanade!
I had a lot of fun shopping with you♪>

rows.Speaker: Message from Saki
rows.Line: <If possible, would you like to go to a cafe with Ichi and me sometime?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's from Tenma...
And she's already inviting me to meet with her again.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I received a message from Tenma...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She asked if I'd like to go to a cafe with her and Hoshino.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, that's great♪
Saki's really nice, so I'm sure you two will hit it off!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She even went out of her way to make sure Ichika would be there. That's pretty sharp of her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You'll have an easier time talking to her if someone you both know is also there, no...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, before I forget, I'll reply to her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“Thank you very much for inviting me”...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'd go with something a little more casual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I'm really looking forward to talking to her again...)
